taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO; native range includes Texas. Kew lists Poa hirsuta, E. hirsuta var. laevivaginata, E. sporoboloides, and Poa simplex as synonyms.

evidence: Kew/POWO confirms the species is native in Texas but does not provide county-level proof.
A documented field account places E. hirsuta in northern Uvalde County along the Dry Frio River.
Targeted searches did not lock two additional exact target-zone native counties from authoritative county/specimen sources.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Only one exact target-zone county is locked. Statewide Texas nativity and broad distribution are insufficient for the project's three-county rule.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not infer Hays/Hill Country counties from the Master Pool Hays-local flag, ecoregion maps, or statewide native status.

morphology.look_here_first: Look for hairiness before the airy panicle. Bigtop lovegrass has conspicuously hirsute leaf sheaths and distinctly bearded panicle branch axils. That shaggy sheath-plus-bearded-node combination is much more useful than panicle shape alone.
diagnostic_traits: leaf sheaths conspicuously hirsute with hairy outer margins
sheath mouth/oral region ciliate; ligule a fringe of hairs
leaf blades relatively broad for the group, about 4–8 mm wide
large open ovate panicle, often 25–60 cm long
small spikelets with few fertile florets

confusers.separator: E. intermedia has mostly glabrous leaf sheaths and only sparse panicle-axil hairs. E. hirsuta is much hairier on both the sheath surface and panicle branch nodes.
E. trichodes has long hairs concentrated at the sheath apex/collar but the sheath surface itself is generally smooth; E. hirsuta is hirsute across the sheaths and has bearded panicle axils.

photo_verification.provenance_note: Hold canonical native install until the third exact target-zone county is established; morphology package is otherwise usable for future comparison training.

installation_guardrail: Do not install as a target-zone native while fewer than three exact native target counties are documented.
